title: Orbital Strike Cannon with Command Blocks (Tutorial)
description:
This is a short tutorial showcasing this system I made for a working orbital strike cannon using only command blocks in java minecraft.

World Download:
https://www.mediafire.com/file/ktn8swcc3n8ztf3/OrbitalStrikeCannon.zip/file

Commands
(replace every (GREATER-THAN), with a greater-than sign, the left facing arrow you get by pressing "shift + ." this is because for some reason youtube won't let me put it in a description)

In-chat (Set-up scoreboards)
-scoreboard objectives add rclick2 minecraft.used:minecraft.fishing_rod

-scoreboard objectives add zero dummy

-scoreboard objectives add drop dummy

Standalone repeating command blocks:
-scoreboard players set @a zero 1

-execute as @e[type=tnt,tag=nukep1] at @s unless entity @e[tag=nukerotate1] run summon minecraft:armor_stand ~ ~ ~ {Invisible:1b,NoBasePlate:1b,Small:1b,DisabledSlots:0,NoGravity:1b,Tags:["nukerotate1"]}

​-execute as @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=nuke] at @s if entity @s[tag=!rotated] unless entity @e[type=minecraft:player,distance=..2] run kill @s

-execute as @a if score @s rclick2 (GREATER-THAN)= @s zero if items entity @s weapon.mainhand minecraft:fishing_rod[minecraft:enchantments={infinity:1}] at @s run scoreboard players set @s rclick2 0

-execute unless entity @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=nukerotate1] if score #timer2 drop matches 19 run scoreboard players set #timer2 drop 0

-scoreboard players set #timer2 zero 20

-execute if entity @e[tag=nukerotate1] run scoreboard players add #timer2 drop 1


Repeating + Chain command blocks
-(REPEATING)execute as @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=nuke,tag=rotated] at @s unless block ~ ~ ~ air run summon minecraft:armor_stand ~ ~ ~ {Invisible:1b,NoBasePlate:1b,Small:1b,DisabledSlots:0,Tags:["nukepos"]}
-(CHAIN)execute as @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=nuke,tag=rotated] at @s unless block ~ ~ ~ air run kill @s

-(REPEATING)execute as @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=nukepos] at @s run summon tnt ~ ~25 ~ {fuse:80,Tags:["nukep1"]}
-(CHAIN)execute as @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=nukepos] at @s run kill @s
-(CHAIN)execute as @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=nukepos] at @s run kill @s

-(REPEATING)execute as @a if score @s rclick2 (GREATER-THAN)= @s zero if items entity @s weapon.mainhand minecraft:fishing_rod[minecraft:enchantments={infinity:1}] at @s run summon minecraft:armor_stand ~ 500 ~ {Invisible:1b,NoBasePlate:1b,Small:1b,DisabledSlots:0,Tags:["nuke"],NoGravity:1b}
-(CHAIN)execute as @a if score @s rclick2 (GREATER-THAN)= @s zero if items entity @s weapon.mainhand minecraft:fishing_rod[minecraft:enchantments={infinity:1}] at @s run kill @e[type=minecraft:fishing_bobber,distance=..5]
-(CHAIN)execute as @a if score @s rclick2 (GREATER-THAN)= @s zero if items entity @s weapon.mainhand minecraft:fishing_rod[minecraft:enchantments={infinity:1}] at @s run tp @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=nuke] ~ ~ ~ ~ ~
-(CHAIN)execute as @a if score @s rclick2 (GREATER-THAN)= @s zero if items entity @s weapon.mainhand minecraft:fishing_rod[minecraft:enchantments={infinity:1}] at @s run tag @n[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=nuke] add rotated
-(CHAIN)execute as @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=nuke,tag=rotated] at @s run tp @s ^ ^ ^2.5
-(CHAIN)execute as @a if score @s rclick2 (GREATER-THAN)= @s zero if items entity @s weapon.mainhand minecraft:fishing_rod[minecraft:enchantments={infinity:1}] at @s run scoreboard players set @s rclick2 0

-(REPEATING)execute as @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=nukerotate1] at @s run tp @s ~ ~ ~ ~18 ~
-(CHAIN)execute as @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=nukerotate1] at @s run summon tnt ^ ^ ^6
-(CHAIN)execute as @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=nukerotate1] at @s run summon tnt ^ ^ ^12
-(CHAIN)execute as @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=nukerotate1] at @s run summon tnt ^ ^ ^18
-(CHAIN)execute as @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=nukerotate1] at @s run summon tnt ^ ^ ^24
-(CHAIN)execute as @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=nukerotate1] at @s run summon tnt ^ ^ ^30
-(CHAIN)execute as @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=nukerotate1] at @s if score #timer2 drop matches 19 run kill @s
-(CHAIN)execute as @e[type=minecraft:armor_stand,tag=nukerotate1] at @s if score #timer2 drop matches 19 run scoreboard players set #timer2 drop 0
